name: Mershops North County Mall
description: Westfield North County is a premier shopping destination in Escondido featuring a diverse mix of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment venues. The center offers a comprehensive shopping experience with multiple categories including retail, food & drink, and entertainment, along with seasonal events and holiday programming. Located at 272 East Via Rancho Parkway, this Westfield property provides convenient access and amenities for the North County San Diego community.
demographics: Westfield North County primarily serves the North San Diego County market, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals from Escondido, San Marcos, and surrounding communities. The trade area encompasses a diverse demographic mix including young families, established households, and retirees with moderate to above-average incomes typical of suburban San Diego. Shoppers tend to favor a mix of value-oriented national retailers and dining options, with visits often centered around convenience shopping, family entertainment, and casual dining experiences.
